persona: Dr. Patel, runs a 2-chair dental office
goal: Make a 6-slide PowerPoint for new dental patients: welcome, what to expect at the first visit, cleaning and x-rays, payment and insurance, after-care tips, and how to book. Short bullet points on each slide. Save it as {dir}\new-patient-welcome.pptx

Make an Excel rent roll for 12 units: unit number, tenant name, monthly rent, amount paid this month, balance due (formula = rent minus paid), late fee of 50 if balance is above 0 (IF formula), and a totals row with SUM formulas. Fill in sample tenants. Save it as {dir}\rent-roll.xlsx

Make a 4-week beginner strength plan as a CSV file with columns week, day, exercise, sets, reps, rest_seconds. 3 training days a week, 5 exercises per day, so 60 rows. Save it as {dir}\strength-plan.csv

Write a Python script that reads a list of billable items (description, hours, rate) defined at the top of the script, prints a neat text invoice with a line per item, a subtotal, 8.25 percent sales tax and a grand total, and prints the grand total on the last line as TOTAL=<amount>. Use only the standard library. Save it as {dir}\make_invoice.py

Write a volunteer handbook for a small church as a Word document: welcome, volunteer roles (greeters, kids ministry, tech booth, food pantry), safety rules for working with children, how to sign up for shifts, and who to contact. Save it as {dir}\volunteer-handbook.docx

Build a one-page order form website for a bakery: a header with the bakery name, a list of 8 items with prices and a quantity box for each, a running total that updates as quantities change (JavaScript), a pickup date field and a Submit button that shows a thank-you message without sending anything. One self-contained HTML file. Save it as {dir}\bakery-order.html

Write a Node.js script with no packages that holds 9 vans (id, miles since last oil change) in an array, prints which vans are due for an oil change (over 5000 miles), and prints the count on the last line as DUE=<number>. Save it as {dir}\oil-due.js

Write a SQLite script for a salon booking database: tables for stylists, clients, services (with price and minutes) and appointments (with foreign keys), plus sample rows (3 stylists, 6 clients, 5 services, 10 appointments) and one query that lists tomorrow's appointments with stylist and service names. Save it as {dir}\salon.sql

persona: Ben, does IT for a food bank
goal: Write a PowerShell script that checks free disk space on every fixed drive, prints a line per drive with the letter, free GB and percent free, and warns when a drive has under 15 percent free. Read-only, no changes to the PC. Save it as {dir}\disk-check.ps1

persona: Hank, runs a roadside farm stand
goal: Design a simple logo for a farm stand called Hank's Harvest as an SVG file: a barn or sun shape, the name in bold, and the words Fresh Local Produce underneath. Save it as {dir}\hanks-harvest-logo.svg
